The doubled-letter pronunciation mix-up in टिल्लू remained at the last seen attempt; teach-back was not passed.
Meera mentioned cake-making, laddu counting, and feeling hungry during the lesson.
end.parentNote: Meera practised reading टिल्लू जी and joining a question-answer play song in turns. Noticing the parts टि and ल्लू helped during practice, but they still sometimes said टिलू instead of टिल्लू at the end.
